messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-06-04, the Boreal team observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team observed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- On 2026-04-16, the Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change, and since it was not their service, they flagged it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16]
- Cinder runs its planning on Mondays. [valid 2026-04-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-03]
- On 2026-03-11, the Cinder team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- From 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 there are no deploys to the ledger service because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- Authentication gateway token expiry was shortened to 15 minutes because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- At the Cinder standup on 2026-01-30, it was decided that authentication gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, having been run by the Atlas team until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: The Ember team owns the billing API as of 2025-03-07, when ownership passed from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The Boreal team observed on 2025-12-01 that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- As of 2025-11-27, the Cinder pager pages Yuki Tanaka, not Diego. [constraint; valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: As of 2025-10-24, the Cinder pager pages Diego this cycle, not Yuki Tanaka. [constraint; valid 2025-10-24 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-24]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, the Cinder team says to page Yuki Tanaka for anything this cycle, not Diego. [constraint; valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-24; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-09-05]
    earlier: Diego has the Cinder pager as of 2025-07-17, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-07-17 to 2025-09-05; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-17]
    earlier: Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager as of 2025-06-06, taking over from Diego. [valid 2025-06-06 to 2025-07-17; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-06-06]
    earlier: Diego has the Cinder pager as of 2025-04-24, taking over from Yuki Tanaka. [valid 2025-04-24 to 2025-06-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-24]
    earlier: Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager for the cycle starting 2025-02-27, taking over from Diego. [valid 2025-02-27 to 2025-04-24; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-27]
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego is on the Ember team, having left Cinder. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
    earlier: Diego is on Cinder. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-27; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-11-27, Yuki Tanaka takes the Cinder pager from Diego. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
- As of 2025-11-27, Diego Alvarez is on the Ember team, having left Cinder. [valid 2025-11-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-27]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, during the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]

Question: Who was on call for Cinder on 2025-02-10?
